_note: Template for scripts/local/content-run.mjs. Copy this file to automotive-facts.local.json (gitignored, never committed) in this same directory and REPLACE every placeholder entry with a real automotive fact you can point at: manufacturer documentation, a service bulletin, a regulatory/standards source, or a dated GCD shop record. Do NOT invent a fact to fill this file — the evidence contract exists specifically so a fabricated claim can never reach a citable fact. Every entry becomes a `verified_automotive_fact` evidence record; the CLI sets `kind` for you.

facts.claim: REPLACE ME — placeholder, not a real fact. Example shape: "BMW N20/N26 engines specify a 10,000-mile / 12-month oil change interval under normal service, per BMW maintenance schedule CBS."
facts.subject: REPLACE ME — e.g. a make/model/system this fact is about
facts.sourceRef: REPLACE ME — a checkable reference: a manufacturer document title/number, a URL, or a shop record id
facts.provenance: REPLACE ME — how this was obtained, e.g. "BMW Center-by-Condition maintenance schedule, pulled from ISTA on <date>"
facts.reviewedBy: REPLACE ME — the GCD staff member who checked this against the source

facts.claim: REPLACE ME — placeholder, not a real fact. Example shape: "Mercedes fault code P0300 indicates a random/multiple cylinder misfire and requires coil, injector, or compression testing to isolate."
facts.subject: REPLACE ME
